targetPathogens.name: Salmonella enterica (Enteritidis / Typhimurium on Shell Eggs & Packaging)
targetPathogens.dnaDamageMechanism: Cyclobutane pyrimidine dimer (CPD) photolysis and cell membrane photothermal perforation
targetPathogens.uvSensitivity: High (Rapid lethal photolysis at low-to-medium fluence)
targetPathogens.description: Major foodborne pathogen associated with poultry, raw eggs, and food contact conveyor cross-contamination. Highly susceptible to broad-spectrum UV-C pulsed light with 5-log inactivation achieved at 1.75 to 2.20 J/cm².

targetPathogens.name: Listeria monocytogenes (Ready-to-Eat Food Contact Belts & Slicers)
targetPathogens.dnaDamageMechanism: Thymine-thymine dimerization, oxidative reactive oxygen species (ROS), and cell wall lysis
targetPathogens.uvSensitivity: Moderate-High (Requires consistent exposure to penetrate peptidoglycan layer)
targetPathogens.description: Persistent psychrotrophic pathogen prone to establishing biofilms on cold room slicers and packaging conveyor surfaces. Complete surface sterilization achieved at cumulative fluence > 2.1 J/cm².

targetPathogens.name: Aspergillus niger Melanized Fungal Spores (Bakery Packaging & Caps)
targetPathogens.dnaDamageMechanism: Double-strand DNA scission and photothermal structural rupture of melanized cell wall
targetPathogens.uvSensitivity: Moderate-Low (Melanin pigment actively absorbs and shields UV photons)
targetPathogens.description: Common spoilage mold in bakeries and beverage closures. Black melanin pigmentation absorbs UV radiation, requiring elevated radiant energy (>2.85 J/cm²) and intense microsecond photothermal pulse spikes to rupture spore coats.

targetPathogens.name: Bacillus subtilis & B. cereus Bacterial Endospores (Dry Food Surfaces)
targetPathogens.dnaDamageMechanism: Spore photoproduct (SP: 5-thyminyl-5,6-dihydrothymine) photolysis and coat destruction
targetPathogens.uvSensitivity: Low (Protected by dipicolinic acid, SASPs, and dense proteinaceous spore coats)
targetPathogens.description: Standard biological indicator for sterilization validation. Small acid-soluble proteins (SASPs) and calcium dipicolinate confer exceptional resistance to steady-state UV; pulsed peak power photothermally destabilizes spore envelopes.

quartzSleeveProfiles.name: High-Purity Synthetic Fused Silica (Suprasil 300 / GE 214, Non-Solarizing)
quartzSleeveProfiles.description: Ultra-pure synthetic fused silica with negligible hydroxyl (OH) and trace metal impurities. Resists UV-C induced solarization color centers, maintains >92% transmission at 254 nm, and tolerates up to 160°C rapid thermal shock during sanitation.

quartzSleeveProfiles.name: Titanium/Cerium Doped Ozone-Free Quartz (Cuts off VUV < 240 nm)
quartzSleeveProfiles.description: Doped quartz sleeve chemically formulated to filter out vacuum ultraviolet wavelengths below 240 nm (185 nm line). Completely halts ambient oxygen photolysis into toxic ozone gas while allowing 87% transmission of germicidal 254-280 nm light.

quartzSleeveProfiles.name: Degraded / Solarized Low-Grade Quartz (E' Color Centers & Micro-Cracks)
quartzSleeveProfiles.description: Fouled quartz tube suffering from accumulated UV solarization, severe transmission loss at 254 nm, and surface micro-fissures. Extreme risk of catastrophic brittle thermal shock fracture if struck by washdown droplets.

ozoneCatalystProfiles.name: Carulite 200 Manganese Dioxide / Copper Oxide Catalytic Destruct Unit
ozoneCatalystProfiles.description: Gold standard industrial hopcalite-type granular catalyst (MnO2 / CuO). Continuously converts photolytically generated toxic ozone (O3) into stable atmospheric oxygen (O2) at room temperature with zero carbon bed fire risk.

ozoneCatalystProfiles.name: Specially Impregnated Activated Carbon Chemisorbent Bed
ozoneCatalystProfiles.description: Virgin granular activated carbon treated for reactive ozone adsorption. Effective for low-to-medium exhaust concentrations; requires continuous temperature monitoring to avoid exothermic bed oxidation.

ozoneCatalystProfiles.name: Fouled / Saturated Catalyst Cartridge (Bypass Leakage & Clogged Mesh)
ozoneCatalystProfiles.exhaustOzoneExpectedPpm: 1.45 ppm (Exceeds OSHA PEL 0.1 ppm & Approaching Ceiling)
ozoneCatalystProfiles.description: Severely degraded ozone destruct canister with channeled bed bypass and high exhaust backpressure. Discharges hazardous concentrations of pungent ozone gas into the food processing facility, triggering respiratory distress.
